results.title: The Red Line
results.overview: As Stockholm grows and shifts, a single subway line becomes a moving portrait of the city’s hopes, divisions, and quiet rhythms. Along its course, we meet people from different walks of life; each is dreaming of a different future, though none are quite sure how to get there.

results.title: The Last Anchor
results.overview: On the verge of an unprecedented storm, Liz tries to balance her commitments on air with her commitments to her family. Given the opportunity to present one of the most important news broadcasts of the year from a hardened studio, her attempts to manage her family situation over the phone becomes increasingly difficult.

results.title: Looky-Loo: Part II
results.overview: Continuing where the first film left off, the looky-loo killer’s newfound infamy encourages him to push his crimes to further extremes as he documents his sadistic ventures, adding a new metatextual element to the film.

results.title: The Monkey Hero
results.original_title: เห้งเจียแจ๊ส
results.overview: Once upon a time in a land far, far away, Tang Sanzang set out on a journey with Monkey King Jazz and Sha Wujing—However, one member was missing from their group: Zhu Baji.

results.title: Tabletin Sırrı
results.overview: Four teenagers interning at Vialand Theme Park-computer prodigy Mert, his sister Ece who dreams of a career in music, the athletic and fearless Çetin, and the quiet yet determined aspiring chef Seda-expect nothing more than an ordinary summer internship. Instead, they find themselves drawn into an unexpected mystery.

results.title: 2DIE4
results.overview: The film follows Brazilian Formula 1 driver Felipe Nasr as he competes in a real race, capturing a story unfolding in real time.

results.title: Das Institut für kurzfristige Wiederbelebung zur Aufklärung ungeklärter Erbschaftsangelegenheiten
results.original_title: Das Institut für kurzfristige Wiederbelebung zur Aufklärung ungeklärter Erbschaftsangelegenheiten
results.overview: Dying is usually a straightforward matter. Unless the will contains formal errors. In that case, the Institute for Short-Term Resuscitation for the Resolution of Unresolved Inheritance Matters steps in to resolve unsettled claims. But when spokesperson Dr. Kopalski’s sister suddenly finds herself in the chair, he has to decide: the institute or his sister? Life or death?

results.title: DRAGN
results.overview: During a team-building retreat in a remote forest, a group of colleagues unwittingly becomes the prey of a rogue AI-driven drone.

results.title: The Egotist
results.overview: Poor and tired, Amaro finds himself in the need of moving. Along the way he takes part in conversations that make him reflect on his changing position in society and on the anxieties of a young adult.

results.title: The Wanderers
results.overview: 1957. As a farewell for her lover Teresa, Zurda and her friends go on one of their usual weekend camp-outs in the middle of the woods. A time stolen for rest, playfulness and illicit pleasures, away from the watchful eye of Franco’s dictatorship.

results.title: Yezhu Kadal Yezhu Malai
results.overview: Caught between family duty and romantic love, a young man faces an impossible choice.

results.title: Dread
results.overview: Terror takes many forms. In five chilling tales, the mundane becomes monstrous and no one gets out clean.

results.title: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 1
results.overview: The first night of G1 Climax 36 took place on July 11, 2026, at the NOW Arena in Hoffman Estates, Illinois, marking the first time since 2019 that New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) opened its annual round-robin heavyweight tournament in the United States, and was headlined by an A Block match between Konosuke Takeshita and Yota Tsuji.

results.title: No Place to Hide
results.overview: A devoted partner seeks dignity for his late love, a fugitive in Paris attempts to outrun his past, and a young man searches for clarity as he navigates his desires. From unexpected rooftop encounters to a celestial game of chess, this compelling collection of shorts explores truth, acceptance and the moment we realise there is truly No Place to Hide.

results.title: Relict
results.overview: As his crew's loyalty crumbles and darkness closes in, an obsessed anthropologist pushes to capture the photograph he's spent his life chasing — before an ancient force claims what's left of his mind.

results.title: AKINAK
results.overview: The film is based on a story inspired by ancient history and mythological elements. The plot follows several young heroes who embark on a difficult and dangerous journey to obtain the ancient and symbolically significant sword, Akinak. Throughout their adventure, they face various challenges and come to understand the true meaning of friendship, loyalty, and courage. The film places special emphasis on themes of adventure and patriotism.

results.title: Alone on the Torre
results.overview: Elite alpinist Colin Haley lays everything on the line in a legendary winter solo push on Cerro Torre – one of Patagonia’s most iconic and unforgiving peaks
